description: This PHP script handles the cancellation process in the SuiteCRM Upgrade Wizard. It verifies access, performs cleanup tasks like deleting temporary files and resetting session variables, and displays a cancellation message with navigation options.

methods.name: logThis
methods.description: Logs messages for debugging or information purposes.

methods.name: unlinkUWTempFiles
methods.description: Deletes temporary files related to the Upgrade Wizard.

methods.name: resetUwSession
methods.description: Resets session variables related to the Upgrade Wizard process.
